title: Product Designer roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to sharpen product thinking, research, interaction design, and delivery skills, then showcase them in portfolio projects and prepare for professional roles. Each phase builds concrete abilities and habits for end-to-end product ownership.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish core product mindset and research fundamentals.

milestones.title: Product thinking basics
milestones.outcome: Can articulate problem statements, user needs, and success metrics for a product idea.

tasks.title: Read “product thinking” article on Mind the product
tasks.description: Study the article and note three key principles of product thinking.

tasks.title: Write a one-page problem statement for a chosen app
tasks.description: Define the problem, target users, and business goal in clear language.

tasks.title: Map success metrics on a whiteboard
tasks.description: Identify at least three quantitative metrics that would indicate product success.

tasks.title: Reflect on how metrics tie to user value
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph linking each metric to user outcomes.

milestones.title: User research foundations
milestones.outcome: Can plan and conduct a basic user interview and synthesize findings.

tasks.title: Watch Nielsen Norman Group interview basics video
tasks.description: Take notes on interview framing and question types.

tasks.title: Create a 5-question interview guide
tasks.description: Focus on goals, pain points, and workflow of target users.

tasks.title: Conduct a 15-minute interview with a peer
tasks.description: Record the conversation and observe body language.

tasks.title: Summarize findings in an affinity map
tasks.description: Group insights into themes and write one insight per theme.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview biases
tasks.description: Identify any assumptions you made and how they affected the results.

milestones.title: Design tool fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can navigate Figma, create frames, components, and basic prototypes.

tasks.title: Complete Figma basics tutorial on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Follow the step-by-step guide and finish the starter file.

tasks.title: Recreate a login screen from an existing app
tasks.description: Use frames, auto-layout, and components to match the design.

tasks.title: Add interactive links to prototype flow
tasks.description: Create at least three clickable interactions between screens.

tasks.title: Share prototype and request feedback
tasks.description: Send the link to a colleague and note two improvement suggestions.

tasks.title: Reflect on component organization
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how you structured layers and naming conventions.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Deepen interaction design, metrics thinking, and collaboration with engineers.

milestones.title: Interaction design patterns
milestones.outcome: Can apply common UI patterns to solve specific user tasks.

tasks.title: Read interaction design foundation pattern guide
tasks.description: Identify five patterns relevant to mobile apps.

tasks.title: Sketch wireframes for a task flow using two patterns
tasks.description: Create low-fidelity sketches on paper or digital tool.

tasks.title: Translate sketches into high-fidelity Figma screens
tasks.description: Implement the chosen patterns with proper spacing and hierarchy.

tasks.title: Create a micro-interaction prototype
tasks.description: Add hover and tap animations to demonstrate feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on pattern trade-offs
tasks.description: Write a short note comparing usability of the two patterns used.

milestones.title: Metrics-driven design
milestones.outcome: Can define, track, and iterate on design decisions using quantitative data.

tasks.title: Read Google Analytics for designers article on MDN
tasks.description: Focus on event tracking and conversion funnels.

tasks.title: Define three A/B test hypotheses for a redesign
tasks.description: State the metric, variation, and expected impact.

tasks.title: Set up a mock dashboard in Google data Studio
tasks.description: Visualize sample data for the defined metrics.

tasks.title: Present test plan to a peer for critique
tasks.description: Explain hypotheses and gather feedback on feasibility.

tasks.title: Reflect on how metrics inform design choices
tasks.description: Write a paragraph linking a metric to a specific UI decision.

milestones.title: Collaboration with engineers
milestones.outcome: Can communicate design intent clearly and understand technical constraints.

tasks.title: Watch “design handoff” video on Material Design docs
tasks.description: Note key handoff artifacts and terminology.

tasks.title: Create a design spec document for a feature
tasks.description: Include layout, spacing, colors, and interaction notes.

tasks.title: Conduct a mock handoff meeting with a developer friend
tasks.description: Explain the spec and answer technical questions.

tasks.title: Document any feasibility concerns and alternatives
tasks.description: Write a brief list of trade-offs discussed.

tasks.title: Connect with a local dev community on Discord
tasks.description: Introduce yourself and ask for design-dev collaboration tips.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Apply skills to create portfolio-ready case studies and deliverables.

milestones.title: End-to-end product case study
milestones.outcome: Can present a full product redesign from research to final UI.

tasks.title: Select a real product with known pain points
tasks.description: Choose an app or website you use regularly and note three issues.

tasks.title: Conduct 2 user interviews using your guide
tasks.description: Record insights and synthesize into personas.

tasks.title: Define problem statement and success metrics
tasks.description: Write a concise brief that will drive the case study narrative.

tasks.title: Design low-fidelity wireflows for the solution
tasks.description: Map the new user journey across key screens.

tasks.title: Create high-fidelity prototype in Figma
tasks.description: Apply interaction patterns and visual design standards.

tasks.title: Write a case-study article (1500-2000 words)
tasks.description: Explain research, design decisions, metrics, and outcomes.

milestones.title: Feature spec with designs
milestones.outcome: Can deliver a detailed spec document paired with polished UI assets.

tasks.title: Choose a missing feature for the product from phase 3
tasks.description: Identify a gap that adds measurable value.

tasks.title: Write a feature brief outlining goals and constraints
tasks.description: Include user stories, acceptance criteria, and metrics.

tasks.title: Design UI screens for the feature in Figma
tasks.description: Create components, states, and responsive layouts.

tasks.title: Add interaction flows and prototype links
tasks.description: Ensure The prototype demonstrates The full feature journey.

tasks.title: Prepare a handoff package for engineers
tasks.description: Export assets, write specs, and include design rationale.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a senior designer friend
tasks.description: Incorporate two improvement suggestions into the spec.

milestones.title: Design sprint write-up
milestones.outcome: Can document a rapid design sprint process and outcomes.

tasks.title: Read Google design sprint kit overview on Google docs
tasks.description: Summarize the five-day structure in your own words.

tasks.title: Plan a 3-day mini-sprint for a small problem
tasks.description: Define challenge, sketch solutions, and decide on a prototype.

tasks.title: Run day-1: Understand & map (with a peer)
tasks.description: Facilitate a mapping session and capture insights.

tasks.title: Run day-2: Sketch & decide
tasks.description: Create multiple solution sketches and vote on the best.

tasks.title: Run day-3: Prototype and test
tasks.description: Build a quick prototype and conduct 3 user tests.

tasks.title: Write a sprint retrospective report
tasks.description: Highlight learnings, metrics, and next steps.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Refine advanced practices, build professional habits, and prepare for job or client opportunities.

milestones.title: Advanced product thinking
milestones.outcome: Can lead product strategy sessions and align stakeholders around vision.

tasks.title: Read “strategic product design” chapter on Coursera free audit
tasks.description: Take notes on vision, roadmap, and stakeholder mapping.

tasks.title: Create a product vision board for a new idea
tasks.description: Visualize target market, value proposition, and long-term goals.

tasks.title: Facilitate a stakeholder alignment workshop (role-play)
tasks.description: Present the vision and capture feedback from peers.

tasks.title: Document a 6-month roadmap with milestones
tasks.description: Link each milestone to measurable outcomes.

tasks.title: Reflect on alignment challenges and solutions
tasks.description: Write a brief analysis of any conflicts and resolutions.

milestones.title: Metrics
milestones.outcome: Can design experiments, analyze results, and iterate designs based on data.

tasks.title: Complete Kaggle “intro to data visualization” notebook (free)
tasks.description: Generate charts for sample product data.

tasks.title: Design an experiment plan for a UI change
tasks.description: Specify hypothesis, sample size, and success metric.

tasks.title: Analyze mock results in Google Sheets
tasks.description: Calculate lift, confidence interval, and draw conclusions.

tasks.title: Write a brief iteration proposal based on data
tasks.description: Outline design adjustments and expected impact.

tasks.title: Connect with a data-focused designer on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Ask about their workflow for metric-driven design.

milestones.title: Job & client readiness
milestones.outcome: Can present portfolio, negotiate offers, and work effectively in cross-functional teams.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn profile with new case studies
tasks.description: Add project descriptions, skills, and links to prototypes.

tasks.title: Record a 5-minute portfolio walk-through video
tasks.description: Narrate your design process and outcomes clearly.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer using product design questions
tasks.description: Answer questions on research, design decisions, and metrics.

tasks.title: Prepare a negotiation checklist for salary and scope
tasks.description: List key points to discuss and desired outcomes.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback from mock interview
tasks.description: Identify two areas to improve before real interviews.
